issue_context.title: Add tests for contextmenu event
issue_context.body: It is not just an alias, since we fix `event` object for it
comments:
I am interested in helping out here.
Please let me know if any changes are required, this stuff is new to me .
@markelog What did you mean it's not just an alias? Seems to me it is just an alias, since the event object will get fixed whether you use `.contextmenu(fn)` or `.on('contextmenu', fn)`. 
This issue isn't entirely clear and we don't really do more things to `contextmenu` than we do for e.g. `mousedown` so I'm going to close it. If @markelog replies with more concrete info, we can reopen.
We apply special fixes for all events looking like `/^(?:mouse|pointer|contextmenu|drag|drop)|click/`, but don't test it.

For other events we at least have some tests, for `contextmenu` we don't have anything at all. Point of this ticket was to provide tests for `contextmenu` event specifically for the `which` property

review_comments:
We actually already have [a test for adding and triggering "contextmenu"](https://github.com/jquery/jquery/blob/master/test/unit/event.js#L2861). @markelog What tests were you thinking of? Ensuring the event object is fixed for contextmenu?
I think so, but i honestly don't remember, since it was like four months ago
